name: Note Studio
description: Local-first Markdown notes and quick records with AI assistance: file workspace, WYSIWYG editor, tags, full-text search and streaming chat.

versions.releaseNotes: First listing. Local-first Markdown workbench shipped as a DBX plugin: the workspace is a plain folder of .md files, edited WYSIWYG or in source mode. Records, tags, chats and settings live in the plugin's own SQLite database. The Rust sidecar owns every privileged operation (files, SQLite, AI HTTP/SSE, GDI screen capture with a native 1:1 region selector and in-place annotation, clipboard bitmaps, microphone recording), so the plugin page itself has no file or network access. v0.4.0 hardens the editor: in-note search and replace (Ctrl+F, match counter, replace all, match case), GitHub alert callouts (NOTE/TIP/IMPORTANT/WARNING/CAUTION) that round-trip through Markdown, a rebuilt table toolbar (row/column/align/delete groups, disabled states, active alignment) with tooltips that no longer cover the header, and a full shortcut set for tables, math, Mermaid and heading collapse.
